headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Hyderabad hosts world’s first two Rotary clubs where every member gives $1.
No fatalities reported as heavy rain leaves parts of Chennai waterlogged, says GCC.
Pakistan extends airspace ban on Indian aircraft till November 24.
Rajnath Singh to represent India at SCO Council of Heads of Govt meet in Tajikistan.
Fisheries expert B. Madhusoodana Kurup passes away.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad mein duniya ke pehle do Rotary clubs qaim, har rukn deta hai $1
Shadeed barish se Chennai ke kai hissay zair-e-aab, koi jani nuqsan nahi hua: GCC.
Pakistan ne bharti tayyaron par airspace pabandi 24 November tak barha di.
Rajnath Singh Tajikistan mein SCO sarbarahan-e-hukumat ke ijlas mein Bharat ki numaindagi karenge.
Fisheries ke mahir B. Madhusoodana Kurup inteqal kar gaye.
